name: Performative Male
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve messy black hair, round glasses, brown blazer/shorts, ivory shirt, earbuds, white socks, loafers, tote books and matcha cup. Existing small badge/book details remain incidental; no new readable messages. Review self-acting paper crane, one protected cup, hand continuity and title.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Performative Male — Show Up Then.
IDENTITY: exact young adult light/tan-skinned man with messy black hair, round wire-frame glasses, awkward ingratiating grin, brown oversized blazer and matching tailored shorts, rumpled ivory button-up shirt with its small round pink badge, white wired earbuds, scrunched white socks and polished brown loafers. Preserve his cream canvas tote packed with pastel books and the clear cup of green matcha with dark green straw. Keep the source's tiny badge and book details incidental, no new captions or readable slogans.
0–0.7s: establish full body. He dramatically rolls one jacket cuff and raises a finger as if volunteering for heroic duty. A giant charcoal padded weight drops toward his little drink cup. He is still busy checking his own hair with his free hand.
0.7–2.5s: one pastel book springs out of the tote BY ITSELF and unfolds into an immense ivory origami CRANE with dusty-rose fold shadows and bold brown ink edges. Camera pulls sharply back as its broad folded wing catches the falling weight, then the crane twists through a sweeping overhead arc and bats the weight far into the cyan distance. One tremendous bounded ivory/rose impact star with a hard contact hold. The drink is saved without him lifting a finger. Keep the crane visibly folded paper, not a real animal, no feathers, floor, canopy or background scene.
2.5–3.5s: the crane folds rapidly back into the same small pastel book and drops into his tote. Snap-close to him just finishing his hair adjustment; he assumes an exaggerated proud hero pose as exact title SHOW UP THEN slams below his face.
3.5–5s: full-body hold. He goes to take a smug sip, but the rescued drink's straw has bent sideways; he has to awkwardly chase the straw with his mouth for one beat, then regains his pose. Glasses, earbuds, tote and cup remain consistent, with two anatomically correct hands. SFX: cuff rustle, falling weight rush, immense paper-wing unfolding, dominant padded THWACK, crisp origami refold, title slam and tiny straw squeak. No speech, music, extra gold-fist symbols or green-screen-colored effects.
